recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Handle any future changes to List.status, List.mode, or Scope & Usage wording under their own final Jira decisions rather than reworking the already-applied FHIR-7041 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-7041 was a Published FHIR-core List change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking for a list-status value to indicate that a List is accurate within its usage context but may not be current over time. The accepted resolution was that this is represented by List.mode = snapshot and should be explained with documentation about mode versus status.
initial_application: The Jira comment says svn revision 6533 applied the change. Git history maps that to b74c14dda50b984642bf7a77823737ca32841a17, '#7041 - language about list status and mode', which added the paragraph now in source/list/list-notes.xml. Commit 5eca64926ea59e8787586a606abb002475229daa later made only QA punctuation/wording cleanup around the example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes list=List, so the List source files are in the current build scope. The current List narrative still says snapshot lists are accurate within their context but not current or maintained afterward and usually have status current because they were current when prepared. The list-mode code system remains consistent. Jira neighborhood searches found later List.status/List.mode issues, including FHIR-55020 Resolved - No Change and unresolved/Triaged R6-era clarification requests, but no final decision requiring a change to this text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative source already implements the accepted FHIR-7041 resolution and there was no discovered conflicting community or later Jira evidence.
